result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.add_pa_graph()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Add a Barabási-Albert preferential attachment graph. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L2488-L2537){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.add_pa_graph(n, m=2, seed=None) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Grows a graph by adding nodes one at a time, with each new node connecting to `m` existing nodes with probability proportional to degree. This creates scale-free networks with power-law degree distributions. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [n]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Number of nodes to add. [m]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[2]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Number of edges to attach from each new node. [seed]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Random seed for reproducibility. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Generate a scale-free network: ::: {#2d219c90 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_pa_graph(n=100, m=3, seed=23) ) # Returns 100 graph.count_nodes() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 100 ``` ::: ::: ::: {#5bef3864 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Returns 294 ((100-m)*m) graph.count_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 294 ``` ::: :::
